citation: Vinetti et al. 2023. Surgical masks and filtering facepiece class 2 respirators (FFP2) have no major physiological effects at rest and during moderate exercise at 3000-m altitude: a randomised controlled trial. Journal of Travel Medicine
protocol: Rest and cycling at 1 W/kg, in normoxia and simulated 3000 m hypoxia, with no mask, surgical mask and FFP2
note: Mean +/- SD by condition. The normoxic rest and exercise cells are the usable ones; the hypoxia cells need altitude context. Very small n.
